title: Michael Burry increases his bet against popular chip giant
excerpt: Another day to look at Micron (MU). I think I have covered this stock more than any other stock lately. One of the most recent best beats was the historic Q3...
content_html:
Another day to look at Micron (MU). I think I have covered this stock more than any other stock lately. One of the most recent best beats was the historic Q3 preview earnings coverage. 

I call it best because our target was hit on the same day as that Q3 blowout print. Plus, it has been one of the most rewarding stocks to follow in 2026. And that is exactly why Michael Burry's latest move deserves some serious attention.

On Friday, July 24, Burry disclosed on his Substack "Cassandra Unchained" that he sold short more shares of Micron Technology (MU) at $933.86, adding to a bearish position he has been building across the semiconductor sector. MU closed July 24 at $920.95, down 6.99% on the session, according to Yahoo Finance.

Burry also added to his Nvidia short at $210.28, sold more Caterpillar at $893.49, added to his SOXX position at $535.83, and maintained shorts in Tesla and Palantir. It looks like the pattern is consistent because he is not making isolated stock calls. He is actually making a sector call.

Also Read: Micron Technology Inc. Latest News and Stories

What Michael Burry is actually arguing: the circular demand thesis

Burry's bear case on semiconductors, including Micron, goes beyond valuation. It is a structural argument about the nature of current Artificial Intelligence (AI) demand.

He stated in his Substack post that he believes much of the current and future demand is not being driven by end customers. Instead, Burry argued, demand is "financed off-balance sheet and not disclosed," with future revenues "majority financed in a circular arrangement," citing the 2026 Bank for International Settlements annual report as supporting evidence.

  • Micron stock draws aggressive target reset from 5-star analyst

  • Micron gets aggressive stock price target from veteran analyst

  • Roundhill CEO spots major shift for Micron stock

  • How many employees does Micron have in 2026? Its workforce, locations, and layoffs explained

I think the "circular arrangement" argument is significant and worth understanding. If hyperscalers are committing to massive infrastructure spending, and those commitments are generating the AI revenue expectations that justify further infrastructure spending, the loop is self-reinforcing until it is not. 

Burry is betting that the end-customer demand necessary to sustain the cycle will not materialize at the scale the market is pricing in.

He also said he continues to hold Nvidia puts "in good size," and described the SOXX position, together with those puts, as a "large position."

content_html_zh:
又一天关注美光（MU）。 我想我最近投资这只股票的次数比其他任何股票都多。 最近最好的消息之一是历史性的第三季度盈利预览。

我称其为最佳，因为我们的目标与第三季度的井喷打印在同一天实现。 此外，它还是 2026 年最有价值的股票之一。 这正是迈克尔·伯里的最新举动值得认真关注的原因。

7 月 24 日星期五，Burry 在他的 Substack“Cassandra Unchained”上透露，他以 933.86 美元的价格卖空了更多美光科技 (MU) 股票，这增加了他在整个半导体行业建立的看跌头寸。 据雅虎财经报道，MU 7 月 24 日收于 920.95 美元，当日下跌 6.99%。

Burry 还以 210.28 美元的价格增加了 Nvidia 的空头头寸，以 893.49 美元的价格出售了更多的 Caterpillar，以 535.83 美元的价格增加了 SOXX 头寸，并维持了特斯拉和 Palantir 的空头。 看起来这种模式是一致的，因为他没有进行孤立的股票看涨期权。 他实际上是在打部门电话。

另请阅读：美光科技公司最新新闻和故事

迈克尔·伯里实际上在争论什么：循环需求论

伯里对包括美光科技在内的半导体的悲观观点超出了估值的范围。 这是关于当前人工智能 (AI) 需求本质的结构性争论。

他在 Substack 帖子中表示，他相信当前和未来的大部分需求并不是由最终客户驱动的。 相反，伯里认为，需求“在资产负债表外融资且未披露”，未来收入“大部分以循环安排融资”，并引用国际清算银行 2026 年年度报告作为支持证据。

  • 2026 年美光有多少员工？ 其劳动力、地点和裁员情况解释

我认为“循环排列”的说法很有意义，值得理解。 如果超大规模企业承诺大规模基础设施支出，并且这些承诺正在产生人工智能收入预期，从而证明进一步的基础设施支出是合理的，那么这个循环就会自我强化，直到事实并非如此。

伯里认为，维持这一周期所需的最终客户需求不会按照市场定价的规模实现。

他还表示，他继续持有“规模较大”的 Nvidia 看跌期权，并将 SOXX 头寸与这些看跌期权一起描述为“大量头寸”。
